one_line: Local-first runtime where humans and agents co-build custom information systems from a live app spec.
what_it_does: Defines apps through reusable types, fields, views, forms, pages, widgets, and rules; generates WebMCP builder and app tools over local SQLite state.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP is central: agents can shape the application and then receive dynamically generated tools for the newly created live app, a workflow that is substantially more reliable than generic UI driving.
leverage_evidence: About text describes two WebMCP layers: fixed builder tools and dynamically generated application tools from the live app spec.
Claimed complete loop is build, generate capabilities, use them, then evolve the app.
execution_rationale: The description presents a coherent runtime architecture and an intentionally scoped end-to-end loop, but the packet lacks transcript and the submitted visual evidence could not be inspected, so completion is claimed rather than observed.
execution_evidence: Svelte/SvelteKit/TypeScript runtime with wa-sqlite worker and OPFS persistence is described.
Demo is marked alive and three frame sheets are listed.
impact_rationale: A reusable local-first way to build bespoke information systems addresses a real need for rapid, privacy-preserving workflows and agent collaboration.
impact_evidence: Pitch targets humans and agents building and using custom information systems together.
Local SQLite persistence and application-spec canonical artifacts are specified.
creativity_rationale: The combination of a declarative application spec, agent-driven construction, and dynamically changing tool surface is an ambitious and memorable WebMCP-native interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Agent can create an app and immediately use tools generated from its live spec.
Three-day scope is focused on reusable primitives rather than special cases.
usability_note: Potentially powerful but a builder/runtime concept may require learning the primitive model.
red_flags: No video transcript; visual evidence unavailable for verification.
standouts: Dynamic app-specific WebMCP surface is unusually well matched to the product concept.
Local-first canonical-spec architecture.
advance_reason: Strong WebMCP centrality and ambitious agent/build collaboration merit advancement despite limited observable evidence.

one_line: Browser robot simulation where agents see through a camera and iteratively control a robotic arm.
what_it_does: Lets users watch and run agent trials in a simulated robot environment using camera observation, arm information, joint movement, and task interaction tools.
leverage_rationale: Structured vision and physical-control primitives make the agent loop more precise and inspectable than generic browser automation; the agent must observe, act, and adjust.
leverage_evidence: About text specifies tools for looking through the robot camera, reading arm information, and moving joints.
Agent is denied hidden object positions and must react to observed outcomes.
execution_rationale: The concept and simulated workflow are coherent, but no transcript or inspectable visual evidence was available, limiting end-to-end execution credit.
execution_evidence: Demo marked alive and three frame sheets listed.
Web version adapts existing physical-arm/control ideas into a browser simulation.
impact_rationale: Useful to robotics learners and experimenters exploring vision-and-action agents, though the submission is a lightweight simulation rather than physical deployment.
impact_evidence: Explicit audience of users experimenting with models controlling robots.
Supports prompts and behavior comparison.
creativity_rationale: An agent operating a robot through visual feedback and iterative adjustment is a compelling embodied-agent interaction, pursued beyond a static chatbot.
creativity_evidence: Agent must look, move, inspect result, and adjust if it fails.
Bridges physical robot-arm inspiration with an accessible web simulation.
usability_note: Simulation framing lowers hardware barrier; task setup and model behavior may still be experimental.
red_flags: No verifiable visual/transcript evidence available in review environment.
Web submission is simulated, not the physical robot claimed in inspiration.
standouts: Embodied observe-act-adjust loop.
Clear robotics experimentation use case.
advance_reason: Strong central WebMCP use and creative embodied interaction justify advancement.

one_line: Branch-and-merge collaboration for human and agent edits to a live project board.
what_it_does: Snapshots a workspace into an agent branch, stages structured board changes, and performs semantic three-way merges with human conflict resolution.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP enables structured agent edits against shared application state while preserving concurrent human work; the branch/merge model directly addresses silent last-write-wins failure that UI-driving agents cannot robustly solve.
leverage_evidence: Agent branch is isolated from the live board while the human continues editing.
Semantic merge compares base, human, and agent states and returns conflicting decisions to the human.
execution_rationale: The central workflow, state model, and conflict cases are unusually specific and coherent; execution remains claimed because the packet has no transcript and images were unavailable to inspect.
execution_evidence: Description enumerates base/human/agent three-way merge semantics.
Demo marked alive with three frame sheets listed.
impact_rationale: Concurrent human-agent editing with no silent overwrites is a broadly credible need for project boards and operational applications.
impact_evidence: Concrete examples include urgent reassignment, board reorganization, and inventory correction.
Human retains control over incompatible changes.
creativity_rationale: Applying source-control branching and semantic merges to everyday web applications is a fresh, memorable interaction model with ambitious depth.
creativity_evidence: Agents get a branch instead of the last word.
Structured changes include moves, owners, priorities, deadlines, and archiving.
usability_note: Conflict-aware staging and explicit merge decisions should improve trust, though merge UX is inherently complex.
red_flags: No public repository; no verifiable visual/transcript evidence available.
Packet does not establish whether merge behavior is fully implemented beyond the description.
standouts: Strongest articulation of shared human-agent state and WebMCP delta.
Semantic three-way merge applied outside code repositories.
advance_reason: Exceptional concept and WebMCP leverage; advance for its direct treatment of concurrent agent-human state.

one_line: Shared workspace for handing projects between humans and AI agents with preserved context.
what_it_does: Coordinates local OpenCode/Codex handoffs, missing-context requests, approvals, resumptions, and a shared project thread.
leverage_rationale: A shared structured handoff state can preserve context and attributable progress more reliably than copying chat text, though the concept is still close to general agent orchestration.
leverage_evidence: About text describes WebMCP availability in the public handoff workspace.
Listed workflow includes request, missing-context exchange, validated context, approval, and resume.
execution_rationale: The packet provides a coherent feature description but no frame sheets, transcript, or observable product evidence, so execution is capped.
execution_evidence: Eight gallery images are reported but not available as listed frame evidence.
Demo marked alive and public repository reported.
impact_rationale: Preserving context across agents and sessions addresses a real productivity failure for multi-agent and human workflows.
impact_evidence: Explicit problem is reconstructing decisions and next work after a conversation ends.
Supports validated context and human approval.
creativity_rationale: The handoff-as-shared-workspace model is a useful synthesis with a clear interaction sequence, though agent handoff products are an emerging known category.
creativity_evidence: Cross-runtime OpenCode/Codex handoff is concretely represented.
Shared state and approval gate are part of the interaction model.
usability_note: Explicit handoff states and approvals can reduce context loss, but local runtime setup may add friction.
red_flags: No submitted video frame sheets; visual execution claims cannot be checked.
standouts: Clear context-preservation problem.
Approval-gated agent-to-agent continuation.
advance_reason: Promising productivity concept, but evidence is too thin to prioritize over stronger packets.

one_line: Real-time AI coach teaching Poland's 2-on-1 wedding dance through structured timing and feedback.
what_it_does: Provides step instructions, song/BPM recommendations, live timing and feedback using WebMCP, Web Audio, and vibration APIs.
leverage_rationale: Structured tools for exact timing, state inspection, and training orchestration make an agent more capable as an active coach than a text chatbot, though a human or general agent could reproduce some guidance.
leverage_evidence: About text claims a ten-tool suite spanning instructions, songs, recommendations, and trainer control.
Agent reads real-time state and dynamically orchestrates sessions.
execution_rationale: The submission describes a focused pedagogical workflow and a live interface, with three frame sheets listed; lack of inspectable visuals prevents higher confidence.
execution_evidence: Demo marked alive and three frame sheets listed.
Web Audio and Vibration APIs are integrated into the trainer concept.
impact_rationale: A specific cultural dance audience has a concrete beginner-learning need, and real-time rhythm/footwork feedback is a credible fit.
impact_evidence: Targets wedding guests and learners of Szuraniec/2-on-1.
Addresses the gap between abstract chatbot advice and physical muscle memory.
creativity_rationale: Turning an agent into an active, real-time physical dance coach for a culturally specific dance is distinctive and memorable.
creativity_evidence: Combines WebMCP state/action tools with audio timing and vibration.
Agent is framed as an autonomous pilot rather than a conversational explainer.
usability_note: Real-time cues could be accessible for beginners; physical feedback quality is unverified.
red_flags: Visual evidence unavailable for verification; medical category is only secondary and claims should not be overread.
standouts: Highly specific cultural use case.
Multimodal timing and vibration coaching.
advance_reason: Specific audience, creative interaction, and meaningful agent role support advancement.

one_line: Domain-specific WebMCP tools add expert advice and structured knowledge to two live Shopify stores.
what_it_does: Adds merchant-authored recommendation, sizing, shipping, and wholesale tools alongside Shopify defaults, backed by shared JSON knowledge and visible results.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP makes store expertise directly queryable and structured for agents, improving precision over generic browsing, but it extends rather than transforms ordinary commerce workflows.
leverage_evidence: Each store exposes Shopify defaults plus five domain tools.
Tools use tight schemas and shared data with a human-facing concierge.
execution_rationale: The packet gives unusually concrete implementation, live domains, tool counts, schemas, data provenance, and telemetry, suggesting a complete scoped integration; visual evidence is not needed for basic coherence but was unavailable.
execution_evidence: Two named live stores and fifteen tools each are specified.
Vanilla JS registration, JSON decision tables, validation, and GA4 telemetry are described.
impact_rationale: Store-specific sizing, medical guardrails, product recommendations, shipping, and wholesale answers address genuine customer and merchant needs.
impact_evidence: Concrete queries include plantar-fasciitis tape, kids nasal-strip sizing, hat sizing, duties, and wholesale tiers.
Shared data keeps human and agent answers synchronized.
creativity_rationale: The concept is a practical and well-executed extension of commerce MCP, with a smart shared-knowledge architecture, though the domain-tool pattern is less novel than the top concepts.
creativity_evidence: Positions domain expertise as the missing layer beyond generic Shopify tools.
Knowledge mined from query logs, schema, search questions, and Reddit.
usability_note: Read-only tools, visible results, and structured schemas support trust and easy customer use.
red_flags: No public repository and no inspectable visual evidence.
Medical guidance requires careful guardrails; packet claims them but does not independently verify behavior.
standouts: Concrete live-store integration.
Shared knowledge layer for human concierge and agent tools.
advance_reason: Strong execution and credible commerce value make this a solid advancement candidate.

one_line: Human-approved specialist playbooks that agents consult before staging and committing plans.
what_it_does: Matches user-authored specialists, consults typed decision contracts, evaluates plans, stages visible proposals, and commits atomically only after human approval.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP is the control plane for live structured state, specialist selection, deterministic guardrails, staging, and approval-gated commit; generic UI driving would be materially less reliable and auditable.
leverage_evidence: Six typed tools cover reading state, matching/consulting Sidekicks, evaluation, staging, and commit.
Premature commit returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED; only a visible human action unlocks atomic commit.
execution_rationale: The packet details a complete guided transaction with concrete blockers, repairs, approvals, stale/rejected handling, and visible attribution; lack of inspectable frames prevents maximum confidence.
execution_evidence: Engineer and Scheduler find seven blockers and deterministic repairs.
Staging creates no tasks; approved commit creates all three tasks and advances workspace once.
impact_rationale: Many real planning failures arise from missed operational perspectives; selective specialist review and human approval provide credible value across domains.
impact_evidence: Examples span engineering, scheduling, laundry, accessibility, security, and hackathon judging.
Guardrails and checks cover dependencies, timing, conflicts, and verification.
creativity_rationale: User-authored operational specialists as visible, typed contracts with attributable votes and approval-gated plans is a deep and memorable agent-collaboration model.
creativity_evidence: Sidekicks are not decorative personas; each defines applicability, questions, permitted recommendations, and checks.
Every vote, issue, repair, tool call, and version transition remains visible.
usability_note: Visible proposals and atomic approval improve trust; authoring typed playbooks may be advanced.
red_flags: No public repository and visual evidence unavailable.
Claims of broad domain flexibility depend on playbook quality not observable here.
standouts: Strong safety boundary between staging and commit.
Operational specialist model is concrete and extensible.
advance_reason: Top-tier WebMCP leverage, impact, and creativity with unusually detailed workflow evidence.

one_line: Wearable interface that turns authorized WebMCP actions into step-by-step Meta Ray-Ban Display workflows.
what_it_does: Discovers live tools, maps schemas to 600x600 wearable screens, handles directional input, confirmations, progress, results, and provider-boundary disclosure.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP schemas become the wearable UI and execution surface, enabling a constrained device to operate many sites without bespoke apps; generic browser automation cannot provide comparable structured wearable interaction.
leverage_evidence: Tool schemas generate choices, text entry, confirmations, progress, and results.
Tools execute inside original pages while Dusky supplies the wearable interface and policy validation.
execution_rationale: Architecture and safety behavior are clearly specified, but no frame sheets were submitted and the packet provides no observable demo evidence.
execution_evidence: Three-part console/relay/Display architecture is described.
Directional-only 600x600 constraints and deterministic validation are addressed.
impact_rationale: A shared wearable action layer could make web services usable in contexts where ordinary pages are impractical, especially for glasses owners.
impact_evidence: Targets Meta Ray-Ban Display constraints of directional controls and no pointer/scrolling.
Supports cross-provider source, destination, and value disclosure.
creativity_rationale: Repurposing WebMCP action schemas as augmented-reality/wearable UI is a novel medium shift with ambitious systems scope.
creativity_evidence: Explicitly turns web actions into AR rather than shrinking websites.
Optional planner is bounded by deterministic tool, argument, policy, and boundary validation.
usability_note: Step-by-step constrained interactions fit glasses, but relay pairing and wearable text entry may be cumbersome.
red_flags: No submitted frame sheets; physical wearable execution is unverified.
Access model is not established by packet evidence.
standouts: Strongest wearable/AR application of WebMCP in the packet.
Provider-boundary disclosure and deterministic safety validation.
advance_reason: Highly creative and potentially transformative WebMCP interface despite unverified wearable demo.

one_line: Synthetic offboarding workbench that traces access paths and stages least-privilege remediation for approval.
what_it_does: Resolves identities, computes effective access, traces inherited paths, flags risks, simulates a remediation plan, and exposes a read-only receipt after mocked confirmation.
leverage_rationale: Structured graph reasoning and staged, non-destructive security actions are substantially safer and more precise than an agent clicking through access consoles, though the actual mutations are mocked.
leverage_evidence: Nine imperative tools cover identity, effective access, path tracing, risk detection, and simulation.
No WebMCP tool revokes or confirms; visible control gates mocked commit.
execution_rationale: The security case and safety flow are detailed with a deliberate breakage discovery, revised plan, confirmation gate, and receipt; mocked in-memory behavior limits completeness.
execution_evidence: Plan removes five grants while preserving/reassigning one rollback dependency.
Live SVG graph and staged/removal states are described; demo marked alive.
impact_rationale: Least-privilege offboarding and dependency preservation address a serious, concrete security and operations problem, even in a synthetic rehearsal.
impact_evidence: Case involves departed contractor retaining production deploy and customer-data export access.
Graph traces nested groups, roles, tokens, and shared operational dependencies.
creativity_rationale: Combining access-graph explanation, dependency-aware remediation, and human safety boundaries is an original and ambitious security workflow.
creativity_evidence: Simulation intentionally finds a breakage and revises the proposal.
Readable graph and read-only receipt make reasoning visible.
usability_note: Visual graph, staged plan, and explicit confirmation support reviewer comprehension and safe operation.
red_flags: Mutations are mocked/in-memory rather than production access changes.
Visual evidence unavailable for independent verification.
standouts: Dependency-aware least-privilege reasoning.
Strong safety boundary and explainable remediation.
advance_reason: High-impact security use case with concrete, safety-conscious WebMCP workflow merits advancement.

one_line: Local shared room where human observations become credited perspectives, tests, and reported learning.
what_it_does: Supports sparks, embers, named perspectives, capability intentions, test plans, learning reports, sharing boundaries, persistence, and reviewed handoffs.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP gives agents structured access to the same visible room state and lets contributions return with context and credit, but the local prototype's outcomes could often be approximated with careful general-agent interaction.
leverage_evidence: Ten imperative tools operate on the same state as human controls.
Contributions appear in the visible room rather than a separate chat; inputs are runtime validated.
execution_rationale: The product scope is coherent and candid about being a device-local prototype, with persistence, drafts, attribution, and reviewed trails; no transcript and no inspectable visuals reduce confidence.
execution_evidence: About text enumerates supported workflow surfaces and reload persistence.
Demo marked alive and three frame sheets listed.
impact_rationale: It offers a credible niche value for reflective collaboration, learning, and preserving the social credit/context around observations, though the audience and value are less concrete than operational tools.
impact_evidence: Explicit goal is to turn unfinished observations into perspectives, honest tests, and learning.
Sharing boundaries and credit are first-class state.
creativity_rationale: The spark/ember/test/return vocabulary and interaction model pursue a distinctive vision of agents amplifying human perception rather than replacing it.
creativity_evidence: Separates capability intention from claimed learning.
Reviewed learning trail and context-preserving handoff are unusually thoughtful.
usability_note: Small, explicit steps and drafts support reflection; conceptual vocabulary may require onboarding.
red_flags: Not a live multi-user network; roles are self-described and invitations are unsent drafts.
standouts: Strong human-centered philosophy translated into concrete state and tools.
Attribution and honest-test loop.
advance_reason: Distinctive creative concept with credible structured collaboration and unusually honest scope disclosure.
